description: This file defines the SeoUrl class in the Opencart Catalog Controller Startup namespace. The class manages URL rewriting and SEO URL decoding for the OpenCart platform, including functions for index processing and URL rewriting.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Class responsible for handling URL rewriting and SEO URL decoding in the OpenCart catalog startup namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Processes incoming URLs, adds rewrite rules if enabled, decodes SEO URLs into route parameters, and sets default routes if necessary.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts a standard URL into an SEO-friendly URL, handling URL parsing, query string conversion into path segments, and path building.
